name: publication-pack
description: Apply the correct Autor Ventura publication pack structure and review gates to a routed writing task. Use when the medium is known and the content must follow journal broadcast magazine book edital academic symposium or ceremonial conventions. Do not use when the medium is still undecided.

# Publication pack

- Read the selected pack under `publication-packs/` or the corresponding domain directory.
- Preserve its required structure evidence level and format checks.
- Adapt content to the medium rather than merely changing tone.
- Keep facts allegations analysis opinion and emotional material separated where the pack requires it.
- Do not invent pack-specific evidence such as citations documents interviews memories or approvals.
- Run the relevant editorial evals when changing pack behavior.
